gap-between-blocks-large mx-auto flex flex-col text-center"><h2>Kilombo Villas: Excellence in Luxury Hospitality</h2><div class="gap-between-blocks-medium flex flex-col"><p>Set on Sibaúma beach, Tibau do Sul/RN, Kilombo Villas is a 5-star luxury hotel along one of the most preserved stretches of coastline in northeastern Brazil. A high-end hospitality experience grounded in connection with nature, exceptional comfort, and personalized attention.</p><p>Ten exclusive villas designed for privacy, sophistication, and privileged views, with Kibo Restaurant serving fresh local cuisine and breakfast in the villas or by the ocean — reflected in ratings of 5/5 on TripAdvisor and 9.7/10 on Booking.com.</p><p>Experiences include kitesurfing at one of Brazil&#x27;s best spots, horseback riding, boat trips, hiking trails, and coastal cycling. The hotel is also recognized for weddings, exclusive events, and film productions, standing out for its natural beauty and architectural uniqueness.</p></div></div></div><div class="relative overflow-hidden"><div class="pointer-events-none absolute -inset-x-0.5 z-40 flex overflow-hidden text-white justify-start -ml-1 top-0 -mt-1 -scale-y-100"><svg></svg></div><div class="animate-marquee max-w-[calc(64rem+3rem)] gap-between-blocks-xlarge flex flex-col"><h2 class="h3 lg:h5 text-center">Frequently asked questions</h2><div class="gap-between-blocks-large flex flex-col"><div class="gap-between-blocks-xsmall border-border-default/25 flex flex-col border-t pt-8"><div class="h7">What are some of the amenities offered at Kilombo Villas?</div><p>Free Wi-Fi, breakfast and pool, safe, air conditioning, deserted beach. Amenities may vary by villa.</p></div><div class="gap-between-blocks-xsmall border-border-default/25 flex flex-col border-t pt-8"><div class="h7">What languages does the Kilombo Villas staff speak?</div><p>The staff speaks multiple languages, including English, Spanish and Portuguese to welcome national and international guests.</p></div><div class="gap-between-blocks-xsmall border-border-default/25 flex flex-col border-t pt-8"><div class="h7">Does Kilombo Villas offer airport transfer?</div><p>Yes, we offer airport transfer for guests. We recommend calling in advance to confirm details.</p></div><div class="gap-between-blocks-xsmall border-border-default/25 flex flex-col border-t pt-8"><div class="h7">Are pets allowed at the hotel?</div><p>Yes, we are pet friendly and welcome pets during your stay. It is advisable to confirm in advance.</p></div><div class="gap-between-blocks-xsmall border-border-default/25 flex flex-col border-t pt-8"><div class="h7">Are children accepted at the hotel?</div><p>Children over 8 years old are welcome; in July, exclusive Villas receive families with children of any age.</p></div><div class="gap-between-blocks-xsmall border-border-default/25 flex flex-col border-t pt-8"><div class="h7">Does Kilombo Villas have day use?</div><p>Yes. Upon scheduling and availability. For day use, children are accepted from 14 years old.</p></div></div></div></section></main><section class="py-section-medium relative flex min-h-164 items-center overflow-clip lg:h-svh"><div
